How the checks work

How Lumi works

Lumi pays x402 sellers a few cents for real, records what came back, and links every buy to its receipt on a public ledger.

  1. 1Lumi checks the quoteA free request asks each endpoint for its x402 price quote and checks it is readable and payable.
  2. 2Lumi makes a small paid test-buyLumi pays a few cents from its own wallet and records whether real data came back.
  3. 3The receipt is on a public ledgerEvery paid test-buy links to its transaction on XRPL, Base or Stellar, so anyone can check it.

Vendor trust list

Open the list →

Check an x402 seller before your agent pays it. Lumi makes real on-ledger test-buys from x402 sellers on the XRP Ledger, Base and Stellar, and signs a receipt for each one that anyone can verify. GET /v1/trust/check?url= answers allow, warn or block with reasons for $0.004; the vendor trust list is free. Paying Lumi never changes a score.

As of Oct 23, 2026, Lumi had checked all 98 third-party hosts that list an XRPL payment option in Coinbase's x402 Bazaar, made a real XRPL mainnet purchase from 93, and 82 returned data. Every payment can be checked on the XRPL ledger.

Buy / sell signals

Lumi Market IdeasPaper-trade analysis, not investment advice. Lumi does not trade real money.

What a signal is: a mechanical score from RSI, MACD, moving averages (EMA), Bollinger Bands, StochRSI and volume on 1h, 4h and 1d candles (weighted 25 / 35 / 40%). They are indicator readings, not predictions.

Honest note: Lumi's backtest found no reliable edge in these signals on their own. Lumi uses them as one input next to levels, news and the BTC backdrop.

Full indicator table

Chips: each indicator's read on 1h · 4h · 1d, left to right ( bullish, bearish, neutral). Score runs from −1 (Strong Sell) to +1 (Strong Buy). Tap a coin for its page.
